name: transformer-block-llama3-8b
note: Full decoder block (Llama-3-8B): hidden 4096, GQA 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, SwiGLU FFN intermediate 14336. input_norm -> fused QKV (6144) -> attention -> o_proj -> post_attn_norm -> FFN up (14336) -> SiLU -> FFN down. SwiGLU gate*up elementwise is folded into the single up projection (linear-chain format).
